name: Adspirer Retail Media Ads
description: Retail media agent for Amazon Ads and Walmart Connect. Review Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display performance, track ACoS and ROAS, mine search terms, find wasted spend, and plan, create and optimize campaigns, with your approval before any change that affects spend.
accessRequirements: An Adspirer account, an applicable Adspirer plan, and authorized access to at least one Amazon Ads profile or Walmart Connect advertiser. Walmart Connect is available for US advertisers. Capabilities depend on platform permissions, eligibility, plan limits and the platforms' API limits. Advertising spend is billed separately by Amazon and Walmart. Muse connector availability is subject to review and enablement.
examplePrompts: Show my Amazon Ads performance for the last 30 days by campaign: spend, sales, ACoS and ROAS, with totals. Flag any campaign above 35% ACoS and explain why in plain English.

Mine my Amazon search-term report for the last 60 days: which terms converted and should become exact-match keywords, and which spent money without a sale and should be negatives. Don't add anything yet.
List my Walmart Connect campaigns with their status, daily budgets and targeting type, and show which ones ran out of budget in the last 7 days with Walmart's suggested budgets.
Show my Walmart Connect keyword performance for the last 30 days: spend, attributed sales, ACoS and ROAS per keyword, and point out the keywords I should cut. Don't change anything.
Create a paused Amazon Sponsored Products automatic campaign for my stainless-steel water bottle at $25 a day. Show me the plan first, and keep it paused after it's created.
